CPU execution deliberately uses a nonexistent ICICLE backend discovery directory; linked shared libraries remain available.
ICICLE CPU arithmetic parity and CUDA-unavailable rejection are separate checks, not CUDA performance measurements.
SHA-256 values below were collected outside the timed command, not by runtime payload digest checks.
